edge_id.description: Stable id for this edge. SHOULD be present so paths/facts can reference it. When derived deterministically it is `e_` + first 16 hex chars of sha256("<type>|<source>|<target>|<scope>"). MUST be unique within a graph when present.

scope.description: the realm the edge applies in (e.g. a resource ARN/id); part of the deterministic edge_id key

nature.description: explicit = observed directly from configuration; derived = synthesized by a rule. Default explicit.

rule_id.description: for derived edges: the rules/ id that produced this edge

derived_from.description: for derived edges: the edge_ids this edge was composed from

observed_at.description: when the underlying data was collected
